title: 第9章 五爪青龙第10章 做我陆尘的师父你们不配
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
此刻，青帝有种预感，很有可能，大乾神朝会因为陆尘的存在，实现大乾神朝上下六代帝王都没有实现的夙愿！
那就是横扫边疆各国，威压万妖山脉，永镇圣魔深渊，统一东苍域！
一念至此。青帝感觉自己的呼吸都加粗了。
而一旁，四大宗门和两大书院的人看到陆尘用了半个时辰的时间成功领悟沟通木灵之力，一个个脸上露出了激动万分的神色。
此刻，在场几人目光如炬，一个个眼神狂热的看着陆尘。
又半个时辰过去了。
此刻，陆尘周围的青色木灵之气已经非常浓郁，
甚至说整个雏龙阁内，都被木灵之力弥漫。
然而，正在这时，只见陆尘周身的青色木灵之气剧烈的波动。
几乎是一刹那的时间，只见整个雏龙阁内浓郁的木灵之气快速凝聚，形成了一条青色真龙雏形。
只见这青龙雏形出现之后，兴奋的长吟一声。
伴随着龙吟冲天，只见陆尘此刻，身后青龙虚影翱翔，而陆尘身上，隐隐散发出一道高级的龙威。
衬托的陆尘仿佛一条真龙一般，散发出巨大的威严。
“？？？？”
卧槽！
青帝看到这一幕，直接就懵逼了！
这才又过了多长时间，竟然领悟了以木灵之气凝聚青龙之形，凝聚龙威？
青帝此刻直接怀疑人生了？
这才一共一个时辰啊。
青帝还记得自己当初做到这一幕，可是整整用了整整两天的时间啊。

而陆尘仅仅只用了一个时辰的时间？
这是何等的恐怖！
青帝长呼一口气，脸色复杂的看着自己的儿子。
随后，只见青龙虚影于陆尘身后翱翔。
而伴随着陆尘的修炼，只见陆尘身后的青龙虚影越来越凝实，越来越真实。
而陆尘身上的木灵之气和青龙之威也越来越浓郁。
大概又过了半个时辰的时间。
只见陆尘突然睁开了眼睛。
就在这一刹那，只见陆尘身后的青龙虚影彻底凝实，宛若真正的青龙一般，突然长吟一声，直接透过雏龙阁，一飞冲天。
刹那间，只见苍穹之上，有一条青龙翱翔。
在此青龙之下，包括皇宫在内，整个帝都所有的人尽皆抬头，感受到苍穹之上的青龙翱翔，一个个脸上露出了敬畏和恭敬的神色跪倒在地！
青龙！
这是青帝的代表！
青龙翱翔，便是青帝亲临！
“这，这就修成了？”
雏龙阁内，青帝和四大宗门两大书院的人看到这一幕一个个全部都懵逼了。
随后，只见青帝连忙走出了雏龙阁，看向苍穹之上翱翔长吟的青龙虚影，
下一刻，青帝却是脸色大变。
“不对，这青龙不对！”
青帝情不自禁的开口！

此刻，青帝内心波涛汹涌！
因为，陆尘修炼凝聚而成的青龙虚影，和他凝聚的青龙虚影不同！
青帝自己修炼凝聚而成的青龙虚影，才四个龙爪。
content_en:
At this moment, Emperor Qing had a hunch that it was very likely that the Daqian Dynasty would realize the long-cherished wish that six generations of emperors had not realized because of Lu Chen's existence!
That is to sweep across the border countries, suppress the Ten Thousand Demon Mountains, forever suppress the Holy Demon Abyss, and unify the Eastern Blue Territory!
This is the thought. Qingdi felt that his breathing was getting thicker.
On the side, people from the four major sects and the two major academies had extremely excited expressions on their faces when they saw that it took Lu Chen half an hour to successfully comprehend the power of communicating with wood spirits.
At this moment, several people present looked at Lu Chen with blazing eyes.
Another half hour passed.
At this moment, the green wood spirit energy around Lu Chen was already very strong.
It was even said that the entire Young Dragon Pavilion was filled with the power of the wood spirit.
However, at this moment, the green wood spirit energy around Lu Chen was seen fluctuating violently.
In almost an instant, the rich wood spirit energy in the entire Young Dragon Pavilion quickly condensed, forming the prototype of a blue true dragon.
After the embryonic form of the green dragon appeared, it let out an excited groan.
As the dragon roared into the sky, Lu Chen could see the shadow of the green dragon soaring behind him at this moment, and a high-level dragon power was faintly exuding from Lu Chen's body.
Lu Chen is set off like a real dragon, exuding great majesty.
"????"
Damn it!
When Emperor Qing saw this scene, he was immediately stunned!
How long had it passed before I realized how to use the energy of the wood spirit to condense the shape of a blue dragon and condense the power of the dragon?
Did Qing Emperor directly doubt his life at this moment?
This is only a total of an hour.
Qingdi still remembers that it took him two full days to accomplish this scene.
And Lu Chen only spent an hour?
What a horror!
Qingdi took a long breath and looked at his son with a complicated expression.
Then, the phantom of the blue dragon was seen flying behind Lu Chen.
As Lu Chen practiced, the phantom of the blue dragon behind Lu Chen became more and more solid and real.
And the energy of the wood spirit and the power of the blue dragon in Lu Chen's body are getting stronger and stronger.
About half an hour passed.
Lu Chen suddenly opened his eyes.
At this moment, the phantom of the green dragon behind Lu Chen completely solidified, just like a real green dragon. He suddenly let out a long roar and flew directly into the sky through the Young Dragon Pavilion.
In an instant, I saw a blue dragon soaring above the sky.
Under this blue dragon, everyone in the entire imperial capital, including the imperial palace, raised their heads and felt the blue dragon soaring in the sky. They all fell to the ground with a look of awe and respect on their faces!
Qinglong!
This is the representative of Qing Emperor!
The soaring blue dragon means that the Green Emperor is coming in person!
"This, is this accomplished?"
In Chulong Pavilion, people from the Qing Emperor and the four major academies were all stunned when they saw this scene.
Then, the Qing Emperor was seen hurriedly walking out of the Young Dragon Pavilion and looking at the shadow of the green dragon flying and chanting in the sky,
The next moment, Qingdi's expression changed drastically.
"No, this Qinglong is wrong!"
Qing Emperor couldn't help but speak!
At this moment, Emperor Qing's heart was filled with turmoil!
Because the azure dragon phantom condensed by Lu Chen's practice is different from the azure dragon phantom he condensed!
The green dragon phantom formed by the Qing Emperor's own cultivation only has four dragon claws.
